notes.title: Update（2/13）
notes.notes:
- Added "Freeze".

- Changed the effect of some units.

- Added some animations.

- Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: About special time
notes.notes:
The number of concurrent users is small and can not be matched.
I set a special time zone in the game so that we can improve even a little.

Choice mode
-8:00 a.m.   (Washington, DC) (UTC 13:00 p.m.)
-10:00 p.m. (Washington, DC) (UTC 3:00 a.m.) 

Other
-9:00 a.m.   (Washington, DC) (UTC 14:00 p.m.)
-11:00 p.m. (Washington, DC) (UTC 4:00 a.m.) 

In the meantime, you can get 3 skins after match.
I hope it will be possible to match even a little.
